content:
As the Liquid Glass redesign continues to roll out to most iOS WhatsApp users, the messaging platform is testing another visual change, this time focusing on the appearance of chat bubbles. Here's what we know so far.

Brand new, rounder chat bubble design

A few months ago, WhatsApp finally began rolling out the Liquid Glass redesign more broadly after months of testing and refinement, distributing it via TestFlight to some selected users.

Around the same time, WABetaInfo discovered signs in the app's code indicating that WhatsApp's chat bubbles would be redesigned. The site's latest report states that the new bubble design has begun rolling out to some users on the latest TestFlight version.

The following is quoted from WABetaInfo's report:

In addition to changes in the shape of message bubbles, the new design also changes how media and links are displayed in conversations. WhatsApp has removed the green borders around them, making photos, videos, animated GIFs and link previews look cleaner and more uniform.

According to WABetaInfo, the new design is currently only available to a small number of users on the WhatsApp TestFlight version, and there is no confirmed timeline for when it will be rolled out more broadly to all iOS users.
